_note: Sites the scanner-fidelity check visits. NOT a corpus: nothing here is published, ranked, or counted in any statistic. The list only has to exercise the page shapes that fixtures cannot: long link labels, non-English policy links, heavy request logs, consent walls, bot walls, and near-empty documents. Membership is deliberately boring and stable so a failure means the SCANNER changed, not that the web did.
